display_long_description:
Step into an immersive medical training experience designed for healthcare students and professionals interested in equinovarus foot treatment and rehabilitation. This VR simulation combines realistic interaction, guided learning, and educational procedural videos to create a practical and engaging training environment.

Inside the simulation you will be able to:

- Explore detailed anatomical structures in virtual reality
- Practice clinical assessment and treatment workflows
- Interact with medical instruments and guided procedures
- Watch integrated simulation videos for step-by-step learning
- Train in a safe and repeatable educational environment
- Improve procedural understanding through immersive visualization

Built for Meta Quest, this experience focuses on accessible, hands-on medical education using virtual reality technology. The simulation is designed to support skill development, spatial understanding, and procedural familiarity in an interactive format inspired by modern clinical training platforms.
